exposure: delivery timing after full cervical dilatation
fetal distress signs (Apgar scores, meconium staining, umbilical cord pH)
cohort: Neonates born between July 2016 and August 2021 who were diagnosed with depressed skull fractures within one week of birth.
finding: There was no definitely associated obstetric condition identified for depressed skull fractures in neonates, despite nulliparous women constituting the majority of affected cases.
